title: Embeddings mosaic playbook — UI mosaic, pipeline diagram, and interactive sample cards for quickstart
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Deliver a compact, developer-focused visual playbook for the Embeddings + Rerank quickstart that can be used in the docs, onboarding modal, and release notes. This ticket covers: (1) a horizontal mosaic UI composed of three interactive sample cards (encode -> search -> rerank) that fit a 1024px content column, (2) a simplified pipeline diagram that highlights prefix caching and rerank scoring, and (3) annotated screenshot variants for light/dark modes and mobile breakpoint. The creative direction should prioritize clarity for engineers: show inputs, the embedding vector snapshot, top-k hits, and the difference before/after rerank with short microcopy explaining cost/latency trade-offs. Deliverables should be Figma-ready frames, export-ready PNG/SVG assets, and a handoff comment with copy for the docs team.
acceptance_criteria: One horizontal mosaic mock (1024px) with three interactive card states: encode, candidate-search, rerank-preview (PNG + SVG exports)
Pipeline diagram (SVG) illustrating request flow, KV cache hit path, batching boundary, and rerank detour with latency callouts
Annotated screenshot pair for light/dark modes and one mobile narrow breakpoint (375px width)
Microcopy and callouts documented in the handoff comment for engineering and docs teams
Design exported to Drive + Figma prototype link shared in the ticket and reviewed by PM and Eng lead
mockup_notes: Card state 1 (Encode): show sample input text, a compact 8-dim embedding visual (bar chart) and api call snippet: POST /v1/embeddings -> vector snapshot
Card state 2 (Candidate search): show nearest-neighbors list with cosine scores and tokenized snippet highlights; include per-query cost estimate shown as a tiny badge
Card state 3 (Rerank preview): show final ranked list with rerank delta badges (+/-) and a short note on model variant used for rerank
Pipeline diagram: include latency estimates (typical: encode 12ms, search 40ms, rerank 65ms on dedicated config) and a legend for caching/batching
Responsive: ensure mosaic stacks into vertical sequence under 640px, keep action CTA visible without overflow
